title: 'Sasaki to Pii-chan Season 2' Unveils Additional Cast, Staff, Opening Theme, First Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Buncololi 's Sasaki to Pii-chan ( Sasaki and Peeps ) light novel unveiled additional cast, a second key visual (pictured), the opening theme, and first promotional video for the second season on Friday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Jujutsu Kaisen & Attack on Titan Studio Drops Cool New Trailer for Big Anniversary
content: Established in 2011, MAPPA slowly climbed through the ranks to become one of the biggest animation studios in Japan. After five years of releasing critically acclaimed series and movies, the studio had its breakthrough year in 2016 with the premiere of Yuri!!! on Ice .
author: ComicBook

title: Sasaki and Peeps 2nd Season Anime Reveals Main Trailer, 2 New Cast Members, Opening Theme Song, October 7 Debut
content: Kadokawa revealed on Friday the main promotional video, visual, two new cast members, and the October 7 debut for the second season of the television anime of writer Buncololi and illustrator Kantoku 's Sasaki and Peeps ( Sasaki and Pichan ) novels.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll’s Solo Leveling Replacement Just Referenced Its Most Grounded Element Perfectly
content: Crunchyroll is currently airing an anime that has proved itself to be a replacement for Solo Leveling , and its new episodes continue to add nuances that make the anime feel increasingly familiar to Solo Leveling , making it impossible for fans not to compare the two.
author: ComicBook

title: Gachiakuta Confirms Hiatus Will Continue With Disappointing Update
content: Gachiakuta has become a breakout hit for Kei Urana and Kodansha’s Weekly Shonen Magazine thanks to the recent release of the anime adaptation from Studio Bones. title: Snack World Reloaded Remake Game's Trailer Reveals 2027 Release
content: Level 5 unveiled during the Level 5 Vision 2026 II Dream livestream on Thursday a new trailer for Snack World: Reloaded , a remake of its Snack World: The Dungeon Crawl - Gold ( The Snack World : Trejarers ) game, and it reveals that the game will launch in 2027 for Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and PC via Steam .
author: ANN

title: Decapolice Game's Trailer Reveals Another Delay to 2027
content: Level 5 began streaming during the Level 5 Vision 2026 II Dream livestream on Thursday a trailer for the DECAPOLICE crime suspense role-playing game , and it reveals that the game has been delayed again to 2027.
author: ANN

title: 'Shuiro no Kamen' Reveals Additional Cast, Staff, Theme Songs, Second Promo
content: The official website for the Shuiro no Kamen ( The Vermilion Mask ) television anime adaptation revealed additional cast, staff, second key visual (pictured), theme songs, and a second promotional video on Friday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: The Vermilion Mask Reveals Second Trailer, Key Visual, Theme Songs and 6 New Cast Members
content: The Vermilion Mask anime has revealed its second main trailer and key visual, along more cast and an October 10 premiere. The anime was previously confirmed as a two-part series, with the first cour set to premiere in October 2026. Crunchyroll will be streaming the anime.
author: Anime Corner

title: The Vermilion Mask Anime's 2nd Main Trailer Reveals Theme Songs, More Cast, October 10 Premiere
content: The staff for the anime adaptation of Dr.Poro and Nabana Naba 's The Vermillion Mask ( Shuiro no Kamen ) manga revealed the second main promotional video on Thursday, and it announces the theme song artists, additional cast, and October 10 premiere.
author: ANN
